These were up briefly on Douban, featuring quotes from Xianzi. They are not on Douban any more.

"I hope the next woman will be believed more" #MeToo 

Source: Douban via Telegram https://t.co/B8P30jWubb

"I really hope no one would have to face such difficulties in the future. I hope the next victim who will have to go through the judicial system will find it less daunting" #MeToo 

Source: Douban via Telegram https://t.co/y8CSBUHsk1

"I don't believe the power to judge women's bodies and judge women's traumas must lie with judges who don't understand the plight of women" #metoo

Source: Douban via Telegram https://t.co/zni62abPVx

"Even if my case did not exist, those who support women, those who take a stand against sexual violence, those who would help the weak - they won't ever give up. We will always come together to work tirelessly for justice and equality." #metoo

Source: Douban via Telegram https://t.co/prTk3jgmd9
